resources.string: Address of your MQTT broker. Required.
Unencrypted — your password crosses the network in the clear. Only safe on a trusted network or inside a VPN.
Only change these if your gate bridge uses a different topic scheme.
Quality of service per topic. Applied on the next connection. QoS 2 is only as reliable as your bridge\'s support for it.
How often the connection is pinged when idle. Default 60. Lower detects a dropped VPN sooner at a small battery cost.
Uses your location in the background to show the gate when you arrive. Off by default.
How far from home the notification appears. Below about 150 m it becomes unreliable.
Also watch from inside the app

Runs a second arrival check alongside Android\'s, using the app\'s own position readings. Only works while the app or the car screen is running — but unlike Android\'s, it reports what it is doing. Turn this on if arrival notifications are not appearing.

rtsp://user:password@camera-address/path — the same address your video player uses. Carries the picture and the sound over one connection. Tip: the camera\'s substream saves a lot of data over the VPN.
An HTTP address returning one JPEG per request, fetched on the interval below — for example a Frigate latest.jpg endpoint. Size it there rather than here: whatever it returns is what crosses the VPN.

rtsp://host:8554/name — an audio-only stream to play alongside the images, e.g. a go2rtc restream. Leave empty for pictures without sound. Point it at a restreamer, never at the camera itself: most cameras allow one connection at a time.
How often a fresh still reaches the phone and the car screen. Default 10. Lower is more current at a higher data cost over the VPN.
Playing the gate\'s sound while the camera is open — from the RTSP stream itself, or from the separate audio address.
Muted. The picture still arrives; only the sound is off.
Require unlock to open the gate
Notification buttons will not move the gate while the screen is locked. Strongly recommended.
Open Domofon on your phone to set up your gate.
Unlock your phone to open the gate
Notify me when I get home

Domofon can show your gate automatically as you approach home. To do that, Android needs location access allowed all the time, because the check happens while the app is closed.

Your location is used only on this device to measure the distance to the home position you entered. It is never sent anywhere, and it is never shared.

The rest of the app works without this.
Choose “Allow all the time” so the gate can pop up as you arrive
Arrival detection needs precise location. “Approximate” is not accurate enough to tell when you cross the boundary, so the check would never run.
The gate screen could not start.\n\nClose Domofon from the recent-apps list and open it again.
